choices.why: Its dark, slightly worn brown leather is the most faithful match to the aged leather sofa you asked for, and at 218 cm it sits well in the open space facing the right wall.
Solid wood top on black metal sled legs, exactly the industrial coffee table described, and a good size for in front of a 218 cm sofa.
Black metal frame with a wood top; low and shallow, so it fits against the right wall beside the door without crowding it.
A black metal swing-arm reading lamp with brass details, a clear industrial piece that matches the dark metal of the table and bookcase.

It is the largest rug (335 × 239 cm) and fits under both sofa and table; none of the options is truly earth-toned, but its rust and terracotta accents on a dark base come closest and pair with the leather.
A pair of woven cushions in charcoal and beige add texture and dark tones to the brown leather with no bright white; this covers the cushions, so the throw is not included.
A dark grey matte pot with a saucer, fitting the dark-metal palette, and better suited to a large plant than the small 22 cm cylinder.

answer.why: The aged brown leather, solid wood and black metal repeat across the sofa, table, bookcase and lamp, giving a cohesive industrial look that works with the exposed beams and light floor. The rug and textiles bring warm, dark tones with no bright white.
